specs: Have a fun time jet skiing in scenic Arizona Lakes and Rivers

gap: Duration exact hours not stated, only 'by day'
blurb: Oceanside Motorsports offers name-brand 3 seater watercraft rentals and full-service parts and repair for motorsports. They provide jet ski rentals on Arizona lakes and rivers, with delivery available to Saquaro or Canyon Lake. The location is in Apache Junction, conveniently near Saquaro and Canyon Lake.
